note: Assumptions for the impact simulator. Each has a low / mid / high value and a source or reason. Change them here; the app shows them next to the results.

stop_rate_red.why: Share of scam transfers the user cancels after a RED hold, warning and questions (assumption; to be measured in a pilot)

stop_rate_yellow.why: Share of scam transfers cancelled after a YELLOW check (assumption)

abandon_rate_after_warning.why: Share of honest users who give up a payment after a warning (assumption; the false-warning cost)

seconds_per_warning.why: Extra time an honest user spends on a YELLOW check (assumption)

mfs_disputes_per_year.why: Disputes handled by Bangladesh MFS providers (Bangladesh Bank figures reported by New Age, July 2026)

share_disputes_wrong_number_or_amount.why: Share of disputes caused by a wrong number or amount (assumption)

mistake_guard_catch_rate.why: Share of those mistakes the 'Which Rahim?' / 'Did you mean ৳350?' checks catch before sending (assumption)

cost_per_dispute_tk.why: Call-centre and back-office cost of handling one dispute (assumption)
